base:
Edit image1, the actual Project Vertex tilted lobby screenshot. Output one16:9 full-screen1920x1080 mockup. Image2 is exact original mountain camp background to reveal where old frame is removed. Preserve the existing six menu button designs, their Korean typography, icons, illustrations and current perspective as faithfully as possible. Preserve the female character's face, clothes, pose, body, outline and position exactly. Do not redraw a different character or camp.
PRIMARY CHANGE: remove the OLD STATIC WHITE FRAME and old HOLE OUTLINES that surround the six tilted menu cards on the right. Every gap between menu buttons must show the mountain/tent scene (slightly dimmed), NEVER the old white lattice or cyan hole-outline. Remove the broad white backing directly under bottom menu row and right edge vertical white strip. The six cards now float independently directly on the camp scenery. Keep their shared approximate y-axis -14deg, x-axis2deg perspective as in image1; do not change layout: top wide EXPEDITION 탐색 개시, second wide dark CAMP 베이스캠프, row3 무기고 / 의뢰, row4 마테리얼 / 훈련장. Never remove any of these six buttons or alter their relative sizes.
Retain paper corner around VERTEX at top-left, small SHELTER paper bottom-left, and existing central-left diagonal paper band but trim anything reaching menu area. Top-right header backing must only occupy top y0..100 of logical1080: preserve progress bar,50/100,gear and small OBSERVE/PREPARE/DEPART text there. No decorative frame strokes inside logical x960..1880,y100..1010. Bottom-right ink triangle must shrink into final corner below y1015 or beyond x1880, leaving the training card completely clear and showing background below it; tiny white diagonal/cross and SOMEWHERE/FURTHER/TOGETHER may be in outer corner.
Add hard opaque ink #16181B extruded thickness/drop shadow6-10px down/right to EACH card silhouette. No translucent shadow, no blur on shadow, no glow, no new frame outline. Enhance separation by gently darkening and slightly softening ONLY the right half of the existing scene, smoothly baked into scenery, not a rectangular overlay panel. Left scenery remains original. The cards remain crisp opaque paper #EEF0F2 and ink; cyan#0DB8F2 only existing fine accents. Do not introduce red yellow gold. Existing campfire illustration in CAMP stays unchanged. No new lettering. Keep character dialogue box and all existing text. Goal: existing lobby with floating tilted buttons, clean scenery gaps, isolated corner frame pieces. No storyboard or before-after collage.
frame_correction:
Edit image1 only to restore two missing static frame pieces. Image2 is original lobby geometry reference. Preserve image1's six floating cards and clean scenic gaps, character, and scene. DO NOT restore any old white grid around cards.
1 Restore a thin OPAQUE COOL WHITE PAPER TOP HEADER BAND across top-right at logical1920x1080 y0..95, x1230..1920. Left end slanted rising to right, like original image2. Existing top-right progress50/100 and gear and OBSERVE/PREPARE/DEPART should sit on that opaque paper again, with dark text and gear. Keep it separated from top card (card begins near y110). Add tiny outer-right cross in band only.
2 Restore a substantial slanted paper wedge in the lower-center LEFT OF MENU. Polygon in1920x1080 coordinates approximately [(690,1080),(920,850),(945,850),(945,1080)]. This white diagonal strip should visibly echo the original large rising diagonal at lower center, have fine gray hairline and tiny black cross near(870,1030), continue to bottom edge. Crucially it must STOP at x945 and never extend underneath menu cards x960..1880. All gaps around cards stay scenery. Do not obscure the character.
3 Make tiny far bottom-right ink triangle smaller, entirely below y1015 where x<1880; it must not touch training card. Keep small white registration cross.
No other changes, preserve Korean labels, button graphics, icon imagery and character. Single full-screen16:9 mockup.
hover:
Edit this exact finished lobby image to create only the TRAINING BUTTON HOVER state. Preserve entire image, character, background, static frame, text and five other menu buttons unchanged. The target is the bottom-right white tile labelled "훈련장" with circular target icon, number06 and subtitle"카드 연습장".
Raise ONLY this tile slightly toward viewer: scale it to103% around its center, translate it about6px up and4px left at1920x1080. Keep its existing paper texture, target icon, Korean text, corner cuts and perspective exactly. Increase its hard OPAQUE ink shadow to approximately14px down/right rather than the default8px; no alpha shadow, no glow. A subtle1px cyan short underline at tile lower-left is allowed but no thick cyan border. Make hover displacement visible yet restrained. Preserve breathing space from the tile above and left and bottom-right corner frame. Never change the text, don't add pointer cursor or explanatory hover label. All other pixels should remain visually identical. Same16:9 output, ideally1920x1080.
